localChanges: Caravans can now set up trade routes. Walk one into a rival's city and its goods sell at once for gold and the same again in research, and from then on its home city earns extra trade every turn, listed on the city screen. A city keeps its three best routes. Walking one into one of your own cities 10 or more squares away, or on another continent, asks whether to set up a route or keep moving (#57).
A Caravan can also help build a Wonder: walk it into one of your cities that is building one and choose Help build Wonder to add its 50 shields (closes #57).
